invariants.rationale: Method returns a non-null Option object; Option types are usually non-null containers for potential null values.
instantTime is a parameter required for compaction scheduling and expected to be non-null.
context is typically required for engine operations and must not be null when passed.
extraMetadata as an Option is generally non-null even if it contains no value.
Checking that isPresent() can only be called safely if result is non-null.
